name: Run Seed Manager
description: One seed to rule the run. Issues the seed every other system derives from — floors, loot, drafts — and guarantees the whole run is reproducible from it, because a roguelike that cannot replay a run cannot verify a death, a speedrun, or a bug report. Daily runs are the same contract with a calendar-derived seed: every player gets the same dungeon on the same day, and the seed is published alongside any leaderboard entry so a record can be checked rather than believed. This component owns seed issuance, daily rotation, and persistence of the active run's seed through persistence.save_system. It does not own what the seed grows: world.floor_descent derives per-floor seeds from it, inventory.affix_loot_generator rolls drops from it, and neither should ever touch a random source this component did not hand them.

inputs.name: runSeed
inputs.description: Player- or rematch-chosen seed. Null means generate one and expose it via activeRunSeed — the run must always know its seed even when the player does not pick it.

inputs.name: dailyRunsEnabled
inputs.description: Whether the calendar-seeded shared run is offered. The daily is the genre's community engine; disabling it is a scope decision, not a tuning one.

inputs.name: dailySeedSalt
inputs.description: Domain-separates daily seeds from player-chosen ones, so a crafted seed cannot collide with a future daily and pre-solve it.

outputs.name: activeRunSeed
outputs.description: The seed the current run derives from. Always populated once a run starts, whether chosen or generated.

outputs.name: runNumber
outputs.description: Runs started on this profile. Lifetime context for meta progression and telemetry.
